thread:
Priya Nair: quick sync - need to pick default ownership for SA tokens before quota/telemetry rollout. billing attribution is messy when SAs float across projects. project-scoped by default or allow user-owned floating tokens?
Alex Kim: project-scoped by default. simplest for billing/quotas. avoids surprise chargebacks. :+1:
Jordan Lee: project-scoped helps metering but cross-project workflows exist. propose hybrid: token has immutable origin_project + mutable current_project (set on exchange). attribution default = origin_project unless exchange includes explicit charge flag.
Priya Nair: good hybrid. we must standardize telemetry fields so Console/billing can compute either origin or current.
Maya (design): UX: if origin != current, show a small banner "Used in proj X via exchange from Y". if user opts to switch charge, show confirm modal with cost estimate.
Alex Kim: implementationally, mutable current_project can be handled by issuing ephemeral impersonation tokens at auth-proxy (avoid DB writes). need atomicity on exchange.
Jordan Lee: sample exchange API idea:
POST /v1/token/exchange
Auth: Bearer SA_TOKEN
{ "target_project": "proj-123", "charge_to_target": false }
Response: short-lived JWT with claims origin_project=proj-999, current_project=proj-123, actor=sa:svc-42
Priya Nair: telemetry events we should emit: token_id, origin_project, current_project, actor, exchange_reason, exchange_tier, route (hosted/dedicated/private).
SRE-Bot: suggest event name `auth.exchange` with fields ["token_id","origin_project","current_project","actor","exchange_duration_ms","route","node_id","latency_ms"]. keep small.
Alex Kim: billing concern: default must be deterministic. propose default billing = origin_project. add explicit opt-in flag on exchange to bill current_project; log and record consent.
Maya (design): UI must show "charged to" clearly in the exchange flow. require second confirm click when opting to charge target project.
Jordan Lee: migration pain: legacy floating tokens exist. idea: detect tokens already used cross-project and mark them as legacy-floating; keep behavior for those but make new tokens origin-locked.
Priya Nair: rollout plan: 1) emit `auth.exchange` events 2 weeks (observe) 2) Console shows origin/current and charge hint 3) add opt-in flag to exchange API 4) default billing = origin for 30-day canary 5) then origin lock for new tokens + migration tool for legacy tokens.
Alex Kim: add telemetry gate: if >95% of exchanges in canary used opt-in-to-current, re-evaluate.
Jordan Lee: add auditing endpoint so sec teams can query tokens exchanged into a project over a time window.
Priya Nair: action items: Alex draft opt-in flag + API shape; Jordan draft token claim format and proxy flow; Maya mock console banners & confirm modal; SRE-Bot propose event schema + retention. I'll schedule 30-min review Thurs.
Maya (design): small UX note: add tooltip on token list: "origin project locks new tokens to this project; legacy tokens may behave differently."
Alex Kim: engineering note: keep Authorization header stable for downstream. prefer `X-Forwarded-Actor` instead of rewriting bearer tokens. less breakage.
Jordan Lee: agree. exchange returns short JWT for internal infra; set `X-Forwarded-Actor`. provide compatibility shim in auth-proxy for services expecting bearer.
Priya Nair: thanks all — I'll post draft rollout doc to eng-platform repo and tag thread. meeting invite soon. :calendar:
